properties.name: Falcon-512 (Fast-Fourier Lattice-based Compact Signature Scheme)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(N log N) floating-point FFT/NTRU operations, N=512
properties.algebraic_structure: NTRU lattice over ring Z[X]/(X^512 + 1) with prime q = 12289

properties.name: Fast Fourier Sampling over NTRU Lattices
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(N log N) double-precision IEEE-754 complex operations; Space: O(N)
properties.algebraic_basis: Complex embedding field C[X]/(X^N + 1) with GPV Gaussian sampling tree
properties.algorithm_variant: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) / Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) tree

properties.name: AVX2 (Advanced Vector Extensions 2)
properties.throughput_bounds: 4 parallel 64-bit double-precision floating-point operations per 256-bit SIMD cycle

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Fused Multiply-Add: ymm1 = (ymm2 * ymm3/m256) + ymm1 for 4 packed double-precision floats
Add packed double-precision floating-point values from ymm2 and ymm3/m256 and store in ymm1

properties.alignment_requirement: 32-byte boundary for aligned SIMD memory access (VMOVAPD)

properties.operation: Accelerates Gaussian sampling over NTRU lattices in signature generation

properties.vector_width: 4x 64-bit double-precision complex values processed per SIMD vector lane

properties.stage: Complex butterfly inner multiplication-accumulation step in FFT tree traversal
Vector addition stage of complex double-precision FFT butterfly nodes

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 256-bit vector registers containing 4 double-precision floating-point numbers
